articles.summary: Pod Point, one of the UK’s leading EV charging providers, recently entered a new energy flex market, becoming the first company to sell energy in the wholesale market under the new P415 regulations. By partnering with Enode, Pod Point is progressing its Energy Flex strategy; helping customers charge their EVs at the most cost-effective times while supporting the Grid with demand-balancing.
articles.title: How Pod Point and Enode are enabling wholesale EV flexibility

articles.summary: Clever's connects directly to EVs via Enode’s API to access real time state of charge and charge rate data, and make smart charging even smarter.
articles.title: Clever and Enode partner to build state-of-the-art smart charging with real-time EV data
